services.desc: Experience the best daytona beach dolphin watch aboard the luxurious Seawind 1000 catamaran. Perfect for private and public tours, this 36-foot vessel offers unmatched stability and comfort, ensuring a memorable experience for all passengers. Whether you're enjoying a serene river cruise or spotting dolphins in their natural habitat, the Howling Owl guarantees a unique adventure. Join us today for an unforgettable journey that combines the beauty of Daytona Beach with the thrill of marine life exploration. The Howling Owl is an Australian made (licensed for charter in US waters) Seawind 1000 Catamaran. If you are concerned about getting seasick rejoice! Catamarans sail completely level

blurb: Our cruises and tours on the Howling Owl offer an intimate and unforgettable experience of Daytona Beach cruising the Intracoastal Waterway. Departing from behind Caribbean Jack's, you'll enjoy stunning views of the Halifax River and its wildlife, including dolphins. Whether you're planning a special occasion or a relaxed outing, Howling Owl Sailing provides both public and private boat tours with top-notch service
